narrative.overview: A clean-white roster you can read at a glance. Tzu Chi blue is the one voice in the system — it lands on the primary action, the toggle's on-state, the current page in the pager, the active nav link. Everything else is a calibrated slate-grey ramp: near-white surfaces, hairline dividers, body type that doesn't shout. Structure is made by spacing and weight, not by colored panels or display fonts. The system explicitly rejects the cream/wood baseline an earlier pass produced (the user named it 「整體顏色很奇怪」) and 標楷體 on admin chrome (ceremonial, not operational).
keyCharacteristics: Body surface is true white (#ffffff). Surfaces sit on a four-step cool-slate ramp: #ffffff → #f8fafc → #f1f5f9 → #e5e7eb.
One accent — Tzu Chi Blue (#2c6cb5) — appears on ≤5% of any screen: primary CTA, toggle-on, current-page pager button, active nav link, public-state label.
Tables are the dominant pattern. State is single-line text (公開 · 在 N 個 playlist), never two-stacked badges.
All text uses the OS sans stack with Noto Sans TC / PingFang TC for Traditional Chinese. Material Symbols Rounded is the only webfont.
Motion is 120ms ease — feedback only, no choreography. Reduced-motion override clamps to ~0.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Tzu Chi Blue is the only saturated colour on any screen. Semantic tones (success / warning / danger) are not accents — they're meaning-bearing context inside toasts and banners.

rules.name: The Four-Tier Surface Rule
rules.body: Every surface above the document floor is exactly one of four tiers: Bg / Inset / Hover / Stroke-bordered. New surfaces do not invent a fifth.

rules.name: The No-Stripe Rule
rules.body: border-left and border-right greater than 1px as coloured accents on banners, cards, callouts, or list items are forbidden. Side stripes are an AI-slop tell.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Body and headings share the OS sans stack. Hierarchy via weight (400 → 600), size (12 → 24px), and letter-spacing (0 → ±0.01em). Adding 標楷體, serif, or any display family is forbidden in admin chrome.

rules.name: The One Uppercase Tier Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + letter-spacing appears at exactly one size (the Label tier).

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule (Resting State)
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. box-shadow is reserved for ephemeral overlays (toasts) and the sticky selection bar.

rules.name: The Backdrop-Over-Float Rule
rules.body: Modal dialogs sit on a rgba(0,0,0,0.6) backdrop rather than floating on a drop shadow.

dos: Do use Tzu Chi Blue on ≤5% of any screen — primary CTA, toggle on, current-page pager button, active nav link, public-state label.
Do use the four-tier surface ramp (Bg / Inset / Hover / Stroke).
Do carry table column headers, panel-head labels in the picker, and form-field labels in the Label tier (12px / 600 / letter-spacing 0.6px / uppercase / ink-muted).
Do render row state as one line of typography — '公開 · 在 N 個 playlist'. Single baseline, no pills.
Do lead destructive actions with a confirm-modal that names the collateral effect.
Do classify HTTP errors into Chinese-readable categories before showing them.
Do keep the OS sans stack throughout.
donts: Don't use 標楷體 / DFKai-SB / any ceremonial display font in admin chrome.
Don't ship cream / sand / paper / wood / earth-tone palettes in admin. Body bg is white; surfaces are cool slate.
Don't ship corporate-tech hero gradients, scroll-driven choreography, or hero-metric tiles.
Don't add antique-government-portal scaffolding — heart icons, 3D bevels, neon list rows.
Don't drop Buddhist iconography into admin chrome.
Don't clone the Notion / Linear all-white-and-Inter look — Tzu Chi Blue on active nav and public-state label is what distinguishes this.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a coloured stripe.
Don't stack two badges in a status cell. State is one line of typography.
Don't introduce a fifth surface tier.
Don't introduce gradient text, gradient fills, or glass / blur cards.
Don't add a second uppercase tier.
Don't show raw HTTP codes to users.
Don't use outline: none on inputs or buttons without replacing with a visible focus indicator.
